[EFFECT_WRITES_OWN_SOURCE] effect "effect" re-ran because of its own write: it wrote "signal", which fed back into its inputs. Two flushes to settle, and the screen rendered the pre-write value in between. The written value is a function of what the effect reads — compute it in a memo (or normalize where the source is written) instead of correcting it after the fact.
  in <Probe> › effect

[EFFECT_RELAY_TEAR] effect "effect" ran twice for one write of "signal": once in the flush where "signal" changed, and again after effect "effect" relayed it by writing "signal" — the first frame showed the new "signal" with the stale "signal". The written value is "signal" itself: read "signal" where "signal" is read (or createMemo it if a stable derivation is needed) and delete the effect.
  in <Probe> › effect
